```ruby title="Ruby"

result = LiterLlm.speech(LiterLlm::CreateSpeechRequest.new(input: 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.', model: 'tts-1-hd', response_format: 'mp3', speed: 1.0, voice: 'nova'))
```
